items.html: But what I did receive is that the ten Sefirot of the head are in their order, from Keter to Malchut, with Malchut at the end of them all, even in the aspect of the encompassing ones; and they are not like the encompassing ones of the beard, which are from below upward. Thus it is found that the last Sefira of the skull, which is Malchut, is in the corners (pe'ot) of the head; and even though they are two, they are called one, as above, in the first correction of the beard.
